defs.def: to hit sb/sth with your foot 踢；踹

ex.s: I stopped the ball and kicked it hardly back to the playground.
ex.t: 我停下球，用力把它踢回操场。

ex.s: In the Chinese language, cu means to kick" and ju means “a ball made of leather ".
ex.t: 在中文中，cu的意思是踢，ju的意思是用皮革做的球。

defs.def: to move your legs as if you were kicking sth 踢蹬；踢（腿）

ex.s: Even after more than a thousand years have passed, we can still feel the power within its burning eyes, bared teeth and kicking hooves.
ex.t: 即使过了一千多年，我们仍能感受到它燃烧的双目、龇起的牙齿和踢动的蹄子中所蕴含的力量。

defs.def: to be annoyed with yourself because you have done sth stupid, missed an opportunity, etc. （因干了蠢事、失去良机等）对（自己）生气
to score points by kicking the ball 体育运动，如足球和橄榄球

ex.s: He developed a talent for football by kicking a ball made of rubbish around the streets.
ex.t: 他在街头踢用垃圾做成的球，练就了足球天赋。

defs.def: to be lying somewhere not being used 通常用于进行时
to go from one place to another with no particular purpose （无目的地）四处游荡，闲逛，到处走
to begin to take effect 开始生效（或见效）
to give your share of money or help 捐献；捐助；缴付
when a football (soccer) game or a team, etc. kicks off, the game starts （足球比赛等）开球，开始

ex.s: I started doing anything I could to help them build a little （10）     ．Most important， I began to treat them like （11）     ． That summer， when the other teams enjoyed their （12）      ， we met every day and （13）     passing and kicking the football．
ex.t: 我开始尽我所能帮助他们建立一点（10）____。最重要的是，我开始把他们当作（11）____。那年夏天，当其他队伍享受他们的（12）____时，我们每天碰面，并（13）____传接和踢足球。

defs.def: to suddenly become angry or violent 发怒；动怒
to try to hit sb/sth with your legs because you are angry or upset （因气愤或心烦意乱）用脚踢（人或物）

ex.s: Therefore, cuju literally means "to kick a ball with the foot".
ex.t: 因此，cuju字面意思是"用脚踢球".

defs.def: to react violently to sb/sth that makes you angry or upset （对令人气愤或烦恼的人或事）作出强烈反应
a movement with the foot or the leg, usually to hit sth with the foot 踢；踢脚；踢腿
a strong feeling of excitement and pleasure 极度刺激；极度兴奋；极大的乐趣

ex.s: It was then known as cuju (kick ball), a game using a ball of animal skins with hair inside.
ex.t: 当六月最后的铃声敲响，我带着一本写满留言的年鉴离开，那些留言讲述了写作最强大的意义——连接人们的能力，让我们能设身处地（进入他人的肌肤），教会我们作为人的含义。

defs.def: the strong effect that a drug or an alcoholic drink has （毒品或酒精的）效力，刺激性
